nodes.name: .gomodguard.yaml
nodes.summary: gomodguard policy configuration that blocks the legacy etcd module paths and directs dependency checks away from forbidden modules.
nodes.languageNotes: YAML policy uses a blocked-modules map with per-module reasons.

nodes.name: go.mod
nodes.summary: Go module manifest for go.etcd.io/etcd/server/v3, declaring the Go and toolchain versions, direct and indirect dependencies, and local replacements for sibling etcd modules.
nodes.languageNotes: The manifest separates direct and indirect requirements and uses relative replace directives for local module development.

nodes.name: go.sum
nodes.summary: Go module checksum database recording cryptographic hashes for the server module's resolved dependencies and their go.mod files.
nodes.languageNotes: Entries provide reproducible dependency verification for module downloads.
